title: EVN Cup mission · Level 2: All six missions
brief: 120 s, all six missions: the cargo cubes into the bays of their colours (M1), the rover out of the crater into base (M2), the bricks off the runway (M3), the beacon into the signal circle (M4), the sample into the lab (M5), park in the garage and stand still (M6). Ten starts, ±20 mm and ±3°. Field damage, 10 each, only while that object's mission scores nothing: a cube, a brick or the beacon touched and moved over 20 mm, the rover touched and left on the crater's rim, the sample moved over 20 mm and out of the lab. The score is out of 190, shown as a percentage; M5 counts the sample on the lab's floor (15). Pass: mean 114 / 190 (60). Par: 150 / 190 (78.9). M6 needs your program to end without an error at least 1 s before the 120 s. The mat's layout is a proposal (owner item EC-1).

if(touchesOf_cubeRed > 0 & moved_cubeRed > damageMm & (!partly_cubeRed_bayRed & !partly_cubeGreen_bayGreen & !partly_cubeBlue_bayBlue & !partly_cubeYellow_bayYellow), 10, 0) - if(touchesOf_cubeGreen > 0 & moved_cubeGreen > damageMm & (!partly_cubeRed_bayRed & !partly_cubeGreen_bayGreen & !partly_cubeBlue_bayBlue & !partly_cubeYellow_bayYellow), 10, 0) -
